description: This file declares an abstract class 'Tpm' in the 'cuttlefish' namespace, representing an interface for TPM interactions. It includes necessary headers for TPM communication and defines a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method to access the TCTI context.

classes.name: Tpm
classes.description: Abstract class representing a TPM interface with a virtual destructor and a method to retrieve the TCTI context.
